# Remotfix

> Remotfix (https://remotfix.in) — "REMOTE IT SOLUTIONS & SUPPORT". Reliable IT support for growing businesses: remote troubleshooting, desktop & laptop support, network support, server administration, cloud & backup, cybersecurity hygiene, and IT Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).

Remotfix is actively accepting business IT support requests and AMC inquiries. Contact our support desk directly at [support@remotfix.in](mailto:support@remotfix.in).

## Public Website & Service Pages

- [Remotfix Homepage](https://remotfix.in/): Overview of IT Support, Remote IT Support, and IT AMC for growing businesses without full-time internal IT overhead.
- [IT Services Overview](https://remotfix.in/services): Complete structure of primary offerings and secondary technical capabilities.
- [Remote IT Support & Desktop Troubleshooting](https://remotfix.in/services/remote-it-support): Authorized remote troubleshooting and workstation maintenance for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- [IT Annual Maintenance Contracts (IT AMC)](https://remotfix.in/services/it-amc): Ongoing preventive maintenance and support agreements covering workstations, networks, and servers.
- [Network, Server, Cloud Backup & Cybersecurity Support](https://remotfix.in/services/infrastructure-security): Practical network troubleshooting, server maintenance, backup verification, and endpoint security hygiene.

## Trust, Security & Policy Pages

- [About Remotfix](https://remotfix.in/about): Company mission, operating approach, and transparent business disclosures.
- [Contact & Support Request Desk](https://remotfix.in/contact): Request remote IT troubleshooting or an IT AMC quote via [support@remotfix.in](mailto:support@remotfix.in).
- [Remote Support Security & Session Terms](https://remotfix.in/remote-support-terms): Customer authorization model, time-limited sessions, no unnecessary password sharing, and confidentiality standards.
- [Service Level Expectations (SLA)](https://remotfix.in/sla): Response targets, support hours, escalation path, and clear exclusions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://remotfix.in/privacy-policy): Inquiry handling and remote session confidentiality commitments.
- [Terms of Service](https://remotfix.in/terms): Standard terms governing support and AMC engagements.
- [Refund & Cancellation Policy](https://remotfix.in/refund-policy): Scheduling, cancellation, and refund rules.

## Machine-Readable Discovery

- [XML Sitemap](https://remotfix.in/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URL index.
- [Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD)](https://remotfix.in/.well-known/ard.json): Standardized JSON catalog of Remotfix resources.
- [Robots Policy](https://remotfix.in/robots.txt): Crawler directives.
- [Security Policy](https://remotfix.in/.well-known/security.txt): RFC 9116 security contact (`support@remotfix.in`).
